# GitHub Copilot Instructions

- Follow the repository-wide access, security, and project rules in the root `AGENTS.md`.
- Treat `docs/requirement-fund-transfer.md` as the source of truth for documented transfer behavior. Do not invent or relax financial rules; ask for clarification when requirements are missing.
- Use synthetic data only in examples, tests, and fixtures. Never use real customer, account, or transaction data.
- Keep changes focused, follow existing project conventions, and run relevant local checks after changes.
